Priya (PM): Quick sync — Acme asked for private onramp with per-tenant SLAs. Staggered rollout + hard launch gates. Need runtime/infra/security alignment before we commit.
Alex (Eng): Yep. Need exact SLA numbers. latency p95 target? isolation expectations?
Liam (Solutions): Acme: 200ms p95 for chat gen (small-medium models), 99.9% availability, 1yr audit logs, VPC + dedicated capacity.
Jordan (Runtime): 200ms p95 realistic with quantized-medium + prewarm + prefix KV caching. Need per-tenant routing key + cache isolation. Rough: 2 dev cycles (~3w).
Sam (Infra): Dedicated capacity + VPC peering doable. Staging tenant required. Capacity ask: reserve 4x A100 equivalent at peak. Cost bump ~0.5-1M/mo depending on utilization.
Taylor (Security): Must integrate KMS/HSM keywrap and provide SOC packet. If runtime threat model + isolation doc by EOD Fri we can parallelize review. Otherwise +2w.
Maya (SRE): Need tenant-level metrics and synthetic probe (30s). Alert: p95 > 250ms AND errors > 0.5% -> page. Also want runbook for fallback.
Priya (PM): Plan: parallelize security review and infra reservation. Runtime builds routing+cache isolation. SRE adds metrics+probe. Pilot: 5 tenants (incl. Acme) for 2w. If SLOs pass -> roll.
Jordan (Runtime): Two asks: canary routing policy per-tenant; fallback model variant for emergency degradation.
Alex (Eng): I'll implement canary routing + fallback hooks. Config sketch:
```
canary_policy:
  - pct: 5
    duration: "12h"
  - pct: 25
    duration: "24h"
fallback:
  model_variant: "quantized-small"
  max_tokens: "256"
```
Sam (Infra): Staging namespace + load generator needed. I'll provision staging cluster in 5bd; capacity provisioning +3bd after that.
Taylor (Security): Starting SOC packet now. Need runtime threat model by Fri. Will schedule 1 review touchpoint.
Maya (SRE): Send metric schema (p50/p95/p99, errors, routing failures). Who owns runbook draft?
Alex (Eng): I'll draft the runbook and add automated circuit-breaker + manual rollback steps to ops repo.
Liam (Solutions): Acme acceptance criteria: 2-week pilot, no prompt-quality regressions (named evals), p95 <= 220ms for 95% of pilot, audit logs retrievable within 24h.
Priya (PM): Action items:
- Jordan/Alex: tenant routing + canary + fallback (ETA 3w)
- Sam: staging infra + capacity reservation (ETA staging 5bd, capacity 8bd)
- Taylor: SOC packet + review (start now; blocked on runtime docs by Fri)
- Maya: metrics/probes + alerting + runbook review (ETA 2w)
- Liam: lock Acme acceptance checklist & share eval prompts (ETA 3d)
Follow-up: quick sync Tue 11am to confirm dates. Call out any ETA blockers here. :calendar: :rocket:
Priya (PM) pinned: I'll create a short PRD and post rollout checklist link when ready.
deploy-bot: New deploy scheduled: staging-cluster-provision v1 — ETA 5d.
